title: Irreducible components of the spectrum of a ring are the zero loci of minimal primes
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $X=\operatorname{Spec}R$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum], with closed subsets $V(I)=\{\mathfrak p\in X: I\subseteq\mathfrak p\}$ for ideals $I\subseteq R$. Call a prime ideal $\mathfrak q\subset R$ minimal if no prime ideal of $R$ is strictly contained in $\mathfrak q$. Then the irreducible components of $X$ [def-weil-irreducible-components] are exactly the subsets $V(\mathfrak q)$ with $\mathfrak q$ a minimal prime ideal of $R$.
